continuity: Cheol Mubaek has broken limbs and serious internal injuries and requires at least four months of recuperation.
Cheol Mubaek is the ninth-generation successor of the Shura Annihilating Fist and broke its single-successor, worthy-only transmission tradition by giving the manual to Lee Seowol.
Cheol Mubaek and Lee Cheonbaek first met more than thirty years ago after Cheonbaek searched the mountain range for three months; they fought before becoming close friends.

The Shura Annihilating Fist was one of the world's ten greatest fist techniques two hundred years ago, but its martial lineage was believed to have ended and it is no longer regarded as a current top-ten technique.
Jopil is dead and left behind the Supreme Peak martial art Flame Divine Palm.

Cheol Mubaek believes the Heaven Shaking Sword and Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi could protect Seowol if she enters a political marriage; he favors the Heaven Shaking Sword because of Taekyung's old reputation.
plot: Cheol Mubaek lies severely injured while Lee Seowol cares for him. He recounts how he and her father, Lee Cheonbaek, first met after Cheonbaek searched the mountains for three months; they fought before becoming lifelong friends. Cheol urges Seowol to pursue happiness and marriage, but she insists that rebuilding the Mount Heng Sword Sect is what she wants. He reveals that he entrusted her with the Shura Annihilating Fist manual despite its single-successor and worthy-only transmission traditions, believing the Heaven Shaking Sword or Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi could protect her.

Jin Mukyung violently urges Taekyung to marry Seowol so he can obtain the Shura Annihilating Fist, Blood Wolf Sword Technique, and Blood Wolf Footwork. Taekyung argues that the Shura Annihilating Fist, while still an outstanding Peak martial art, is an old technique whose former status does not make it one of the world's current ten greatest fist techniques, and rejects the marriage. He then reveals that Jopil left behind the Supreme Peak martial art Flame Divine Palm, leaving Mukyung stunned.
translation_decisions: Render 일인전승 as “single successor” and 비인부전 as “transmission only to the worthy.”
Render 구 대 계승자 as “ninth-generation successor” and 천하십대권법 as “the ten greatest fist techniques in the world.”
Retain “Uncle Cheol,” “Seowol,” and “hyung” for the established familial and address conventions.

active_continuity: Pung Yang is dead; Jin Taekyung killed him after the Unnamed Sword's Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron destroyed his Body-Protecting Qi and pierced his chest.
Taekyung fully absorbed the Blazing Flame Divine Pill and possesses forty-five years of internal energy with the Scorching Yang Qi attribute.
Jin Mukyung survived his fight with Pung Yang and has recovered enough to move independently.
Cheol Mubaek and the other wounded Mount Heng martial artists are recovering; Cheol has broken limbs and serious internal injuries and needs at least four months of recuperation.
Lee Seowol remains the Sect Leader of the Mount Heng Sword Sect and vows to preserve the sect for those who died defending it.
The Lower District Sect sent a relief force with physicians, cooks, and laborers after the battle.
Wolhwa's real name is Eun Sowol, and she is the Lower District Sect's Shanxi Branch Leader with authority over more than thirty Shanxi branches.
Lee Seowol accepted Jin Wikyung's invitation to the Jin Family of Taiyuan's New Year gathering.
Lee Seowol offered the Mount Heng Sword Sect's territorial rights to the Jin Family of Taiyuan as an apology.
Lee Seowol proposed marriage to Jin Taekyung in exchange for the Blood Wolf Sword Technique, Blood Wolf Footwork, and Shura Annihilating Fist.
Lee Seowol is seventeen years old.
Jin Taekyung has decided to reject Lee Seowol's political marriage proposal because of her age and because he loves Song Song.
Forty-seven mounted bandits survived the battle, but the Lower District Sect can save only about thirty with its available medicine.
The Lower District Sect is spreading a rumor that the two Jin brothers defeated Pung Yang and rescued the Mount Heng Sword Sect.
Cheol Mubaek is the ninth-generation successor of the Shura Annihilating Fist and gave its manual to Lee Seowol despite its inheritance traditions.
Cheol Mubaek and Lee Cheonbaek first met more than thirty years ago, fought, and then became close friends.
The Shura Annihilating Fist was an ancient top-ten fist technique whose lineage was believed to have ended and is no longer a current top-ten technique.
Jopil is dead and left behind the Supreme Peak martial art Flame Divine Palm.
open_questions: How will the Jin Family of Taiyuan respond to Lee Seowol's proposed transaction and territorial transfer?
Can Lee Seowol preserve or rebuild the Mount Heng Sword Sect with so few survivors?
What is the origin and full long-term effect of the Temporary Strength Pill?
What consequences will Pung Yang's death have for the Red Wind Band and the wider Murim?
